name: Silence
summary: Prevents all sound in a 20-foot-radius Sphere, blocking spells with Verbal components there.

stats.effect: For the duration, no sound can be created within or pass through a 20-foot-radius {ref:glossary/sphere} centered on a point you choose within range. Any creature or object entirely inside the Sphere has {ref:glossary/immunity} to Thunder damage, and creatures have the {ref:condition/deafened} condition while entirely inside it. Casting a spell that includes a Verbal component is impossible there.
